_comment: Live properties the morning health digest checks. Static HTTP targets below; Cloud Run services are auto-discovered via gcloud at runtime (once `gcloud auth login` is done).

cloud_run_autodiscover.note: When gcloud is authed, the health prompt runs `gcloud run services list` and health-checks each service URL. Expected services (us-east1/us-central1): saga-board (SAGA OS), saga-agents, Givers API, workspace-studio/Kanban. No manual URLs needed once authed.

context.intentionally_paused: Per cost-saving, some GCP databases/services are deliberately STOPPED (see memory project_gcp_costs). Intentionally paused is NOT an outage — note it, don't alarm.
context.aiarsenal_note: AIArsenal is on Vercel now (Cloud Run paused). ai-arsenal-nu.vercel.app is an equivalent alias.
